dataset.title: Manufactures imports (% of merchandise imports) (latest)

indicator.name: Manufactures imports (% of merchandise imports)
indicator.description: Manufactures imports as a percentage of total merchandise imports.

source.name: World Bank, World Development Indicators (TM.VAL.MRCH.MF.ZS)
source.citation: World Bank WDI TM.VAL.MRCH.MF.ZS, underlying UN Comtrade / WITS. Table transcribed and uploaded to this repo (data/raw/uploads/world_bank_manufactures_imports_share_2025_latest.json).

notes: Auto-imported from an uploaded "most recent value" table: each entity keeps its own latest year (0–2025), so old observations sit next to recent ones.

World Bank aggregates are skipped; blank cells stay missing (never zero). Observations older than 2010 are not used (they were 1975–2008 for a few economies such as Somalia, Chad and Equatorial Guinea).
caveats: Composition of merchandise imports, not import dependence: a high share can mean a big need for imports of this group or simply few other imports. Shares are rounded in the source table.

scoring.rationale: Share of imports with no natural ceiling for this purpose; rank-based so outliers do not dominate.
